shortDescription: Mike Ashley's Frasers LSE:FRAS on Tuesday said it was reviewing its support for Hugo Boss' XETR:BOSS supervisory board Chair Stephan Sturm, as it announced an intention to raise its stake in the German retailer to over 50%.
